==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Iteri, Zenith
* Announcement by the [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]]

==Date==
* Winter 387YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 20 wains of mithril
* 10 wains of white granite
* 10 rings of ilium
* 90 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

* Now complete, the [[Architect of Hammers]] will be available to appoint by [[Tally of the Votes]] of Urizen owners of [[mana site|mana sites]] for the first time at the Spring Equinox 388YE for a shortened term until the Autumn Equinox 388YE.
